server.description: SQL Server fully qualified domain name (e.g. myserver.database.windows.net)

alias.description: Name used to identify this connection. Must be unique among the SQL connections of the agent. If empty, the server name is used.

azureClientId.description: Azure AD Application (Client) ID. The app registration must list the redirect URI {frontend_url}/tools/sql/oauth-callback and have the Azure SQL Database user_impersonation permission.

azureClientSecret.description: Client secret of your Azure AD app registration.
